remarks: Spacious Ranch-Style Condo in the Heart of Downtown Stamford Located directly across from Mill River Park in vibrant downtown Stamford, this beautifully maintained ranch-style condo offers comfort, convenience, and modern updates all on one level. Step inside to discover a bright and spacious interior featuring gleaming floors, fresh paint throughout, and a newly remodeled kitchen and bathroom. The home includes two generously sized bedrooms, walk in closet and a full bathroom, plus the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. You'll also enjoy two reserved parking spaces-one of which is an under house carport (marked 3-11). Ideally situated just half a mile from Stamford Train Station and the downtown area, you'll have easy access to countless shops, restaurants, and amenities. This is city living at its best!
